response_time_protocol.cover_rule: For positive net depletion, cover = compatible accessible usable quantity above protected floor / (stressed use rate - dependable accessible inflow rate), with matching units and service boundaries. If the denominator is zero or negative, do not claim infinite security: test inflow interruption and shared failures.
response_time_protocol.donor_rule: Protect donor essential demand and contingency floor; ownership, geographic delivery, grade and time determine whether a reserve can actually help.
response_time_protocol.handoff_rule: Next capacity must be usable before the preceding bridge reaches its protected floor; include commissioning, transport and learning time.
response_time_protocol.national_ratio_caution: 107.9 million barrels / 3.602 million barrels per day is approximately 30 days of gross US distillate stocks relative to recent domestic products supplied.
